newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ASIA PRODUCT SWAPS: Arb cargoes dampen Dec gas oil.
newsitem.headline: ASIA PRODUCT SWAPS: Arb cargoes dampen Dec gas oil.

text.p: Singapore December gas oil swaps on Tuesday late afternoon were under pressure as arbitrage cargoes from the U.S. West Coast were due to arrive late December, traders said.
"The backwardation has widened as the arbitrage barrels are coming in end December," one trader said.
The November/December spread widened to 50/60 cents from about 30/40 cents late last week, brokers said.
November swaps were quoted firmer at $29.70/$29.8 from early Tuesday's trade at $29.70.
The market picked up slightly on traders' expectation of renewed prompt buying from China.
Fuel oil swaps were quoted slightly lower from this morning due to an absence of buying interest, traders said.
In the afternoon, November was traded at $115.75 and December was done at $115.50.
November was last quoted at $115.50/$116.25 per tonne and December at $115.50/$116.25, about 25 cents less than this morning, brokers said.
Naphtha was quoted at $21.70/21.95, down from Monday's close of $21.90/$22.10.
